what: On wide screens (1001px and up), scrolling the document past 500px switches the 160px large header (top brand row · big centered logo · bottom menu row) to a 60px one-row header with no in-between values — logo 67 → 35px, brand row·logo text same [data-fx-part=hide] is hidden, and comes back when scrolled up 500px again. Narrow screens do not always use the wide-screen rule (the consumer sets it to 60px). On change it fires fx:compact and fx:expand, which the side that moves the menu receives — in the Hero header row of the company and stationery brand pages

options.at: How many px of scrolling before it shrinks, default 500
options.wide: Width condition for applying the shrink, default (min-width: 1001px)
options.--fx-dur: Transition time, default 0s (original) — use .3s for a smooth change

events.fx:expand: When returning to the large headline

from.where: shared.js header — scrolling past 500px shrinks it 160 → 60px, logo 67 → 35px, hides the brand logo row, and the menu goes on one line next to the logo (1001px and above)
